parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO n8n_supportportal_slack_events (event_id, status, payload)
  VALUES ($1, 'pending', $2::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id, status, payload, slack_channel_id, slack_message_ts, failure_code
)
SELECT event_id, status, payload, slack_channel_id, slack_message_ts, failure_code, TRUE AS claimed
FROM inserted
UNION ALL
SELECT event_id, status, payload, slack_channel_id, slack_message_ts, failure_code, FALSE AS claimed
FROM n8n_supportportal_slack_events
WHERE event_id = $1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted);

UPDATE n8n_supportportal_slack_events
SET status = 'delivered', slack_channel_id = $2, slack_message_ts = $3, failure_code = NULL, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE event_id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
RETURNING event_id, status, failure_code;
